steps.en: Install it next to acpx and a coding agent you are already logged into
steps.zh: 装好它，旁边要有 acpx 和一个已登录的编码 agent

steps.en: In your repo, initialize once, then start a run
steps.zh: 在仓库里初始化一次，然后跑一轮

steps.en: Finds this repo's sessions in 7 agents' local stores and shrinks each to its signal
steps.zh: 从 7 家 agent 的本地记录里找出本仓库的会话，逐个压缩到只剩要点

steps.en: A cheap model judges each session against your memory file; claims without a verbatim quote are dropped
steps.zh: 便宜模型逐个会话对照记忆文件打分；拿不出原文引用的判断直接丢弃

steps.en: A strong model edits a staging copy; edits need 2 sessions of evidence and must fit the token budget
steps.zh: 强模型改一份暂存副本；每条改动要有 2 个会话作证，且不能超出 token 预算

steps.en: Review each edit with its quotes and accept or reject it
steps.zh: 逐条看改动和它引用的原话，接受或拒绝

steps.en: Writes only the accepted edits to AGENTS.md and skills, and remembers what you rejected
steps.zh: 只把你接受的改动写进 AGENTS.md 和技能，并记住你拒绝过什么

value.en: Your agent memory is corrected from what actually went wrong in real sessions — you stop rereading transcripts and hand-appending rules
value.zh: 记忆文件按真实会话里真出过的错来修——你不用再翻记录、手工往里追加规则

sources: README 'Quick Start' (npm install -g backpass; Node >= 22.5 and acpx on PATH; backpass init; backpass; backpass apply)

README 'How It Works' 1-8 (seven harness stores; distillation 96-99%; verbatim-quote check; minGapEvidence 2 sessions; staging copy under .backpass/synthesis/; budget 5,000 tokens; apply is the only writing command; rejections are remembered)
README 'Two-tier models' (analysis and synthesis passes through acpx)
